{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check the first few values of revenue to confirm format
print(df['revenue'].head())

# Check for thousands separators and count non-numeric values
print("\nUnique revenue values (first 10):", df['revenue'].unique()[:10])

# Check if any values contain commas
has_commas = df['revenue'].str.contains(',', na=False)
print(f"\nRows with commas: {has_commas.sum()}")

# Confirm that all non-null revenue values are in format "X,XXX.XX"
print(f"\nNon-null revenue values: {df['revenue'].dropna().unique()}")"}
